What it does

Move speed, within the +25% gear speed cap: 3%. Goes on an armor piece. All your armor together stops at 10%. Halved in PvP. Lasts 500 kills that pay you XP.

Dropped by monsters of level 49 and up. About augments. Placeholder: which monsters give which kind is still unknown.
